description: Targets whose recorded Seatbelt report (undeclared-g/reports) shows reads of rust-toolchain.toml, .cargo/config.toml or Cargo.lock = they run cargo. Each must carry a SEMIO_CARGO_LOCK_* token in its effective key (checked against the sealed generation by lockcov.mjs + cargo-evidence-check.py). `after` = only after the batch lands and the graph regenerates.
